policy: Scan-only, name-grouped templates. Disjoint fit, model selection and untouched certification. Whole-interior replacement must leave all extracted profiles identical. Scan transforms are comparison-only and never enter renderer defaults. Axis scale diagnostics remain explicit; source frame geometry must be assessed against scan-derived templates, never against itself.

visualReview.scope: 302 fixed independently normalized scans and corrected Original native renders at contact-sheet scale. Intended gross pose/aperture/stock inspection, not a claim of full-resolution individual text matching. Existing pixel-scale numerical and targeted zoom evidence remains separate.
visualReview.result: No gross pose, art-aperture, missing material, stock or box-placement failures in the 302 contact-sheet pairs. Texture and text wrapping residuals remain; this is not pixel-perfect certification.
